subject: How to add expressions or greek letters with annotation?

messages.author: ff42271ef6191bca
messages.subject: How to add expressions or greek letters with annotation?
parts:
Hi,

i tried to add some text to a plot using annotate. Unfortunately i did
not find how to add any text including expression or greek letters.

Using

txt <- expression(mu * 'V')
annotate("text", x=0.12, y=0.12, label=txt, size=2)

just adds the text "mu * "V"".

Thanks,
Herbert

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: How to add expressions or greek letters with annotation?
parts:
Hi,

geom_text has a parse argument for this,

qplot(1,1,geom="blank") +
annotate("text", x=1,y=1,label="alpha", parse=TRUE)

HTH,

baptiste
